pokedexEntries.bk: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

pokedexEntries.wh: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

pokedexEntries.sw: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.
